preconditions.description: Number of vertices V is between 1 and 10^4.
The adjacency list adj has exactly V elements.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(u, int) and 0 <= u < V for u in [v for sublist in adj for v in sublist])
preconditions.description: All vertices in the adjacency list are integers between 0 and V-1.

postconditions.description: The return value is a list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(v, int) and 0 <= v < V for v in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the return list are integers between 0 and V-1.
The return list is sorted in ascending order.

postconditions.expression: any(removing_vertex(v, adj) for v in return_value)
postconditions.description: Removing any vertex in the return list increases the number of connected components.

postconditions.expression: all(not removing_vertex(v, adj) for v in range(V) if v not in return_value)
postconditions.description: Removing any vertex not in the return list does not increase the number of connected components.
